messages:
Mia Chen: Quick weeklies before renewal ping: saw a p95/p99 divergence on Northstar yesterday evening. /chat model-r3 sync p95 ~360ms p99 ~2.1s, streaming p95 ~240ms p99 ~820ms. /generate model-e2 sync p95 ~520ms p99 ~1.9s, streaming p95 ~150ms p99 ~330ms.
Samir Patel: Copy. Raw: 2024-04-21 18:12-18:45 UTC spike window. Error rate climbed 0.08% -> 0.66% during the spike. CPU steal on host pool looked low; appears queuing + hot-keyed prompt patterns.
Julian Park: Any cost impact? If they're seeing +tail and +spend that's a renewal red flag.
Mia Chen: Spend bump was short but notable: hourly token throughput doubled for ~35m -> estimated daily spend +22%. I'll flag in renewal brief.
Olivia Ruiz: Do we know whether this is customer behaviour (batched jobs) or a platform regression?
Samir Patel: From traces it's customer-side bursts (large batch scoring jobs hitting sync endpoints). We saw identical request shapes: long context + repeated re-asks. KV cache TTL is 60s for them so recompute happened a lot.
CS Bot: ALERT: Northstar p99 SLA breach detected (p99 > 1500ms) at 2024-04-21T18:18Z. Ticket INC-20240421-91 opened.
Julian Park: Suggested mitigations: 1) flip streaming-fallback on for /generate and /chat for 24h, 2) lower KV cache TTL to 10s for this account, 3) encourage streaming-first pattern in enablement, 4) short canary with model-r3 quantized for sync-heavy routes.
Samir Patel: I'll push the TTL change and add a temporary autoscale headroom +25% for 36h. Also adding dashboard rule: alert when sync_p99>1s by route+model -> page. Dashboard link: <https://redwood.app/dashboards/northstar-tail|northstar-tailboard>.
Mia Chen: Olivia can you own customer comms + renewal owner pre-brief? Call request: Thu 9:30am PT, 20m. Highlight: p95/p99 numbers, spend delta, and quick mitigations.
Olivia Ruiz: Got it. I'll include playbook steps and suggest a prompt tuning session to reduce repeated full-context recomputation. Scheduling now.
Samir Patel: Trace snippet for /chat model-r3 sync during spike:
```
route=/chat model=model-r3 mode=sync p99=2100ms errors=0.9% host=gpu-07 trace_id=tx-4f7b
```
Mia Chen: Cool. Owners: Samir (telemetry/ops), Julian (strategy & canary), Olivia (customer comms). Reconvene Fri AM for status. :thumbsup:
